cases.name: left join update
cases.dml: UPDATE target SET value = COALESCE(source.value, 0) FROM items target LEFT JOIN foo source ON source.id = target.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left join anti delete
cases.dml: DELETE target FROM items target LEFT JOIN foo source ON source.id = target.id WHERE source.id IS NULL; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left outer join keyword
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET value = ISNULL(s.value, -1) FROM items AS t LEFT OUTER JOIN foo AS s ON s.id = t.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: on predicate stays in join

cases.name: unqualified source and target columns

cases.name: ambiguous unqualified column

cases.name: duplicate matches update once

cases.name: chained left joins
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET name = ISNULL(b.label, 'none') FROM items t LEFT JOIN foo s ON s.id = t.id LEFT JOIN bar b ON b.id = s.other; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: nested inner join on the outer side
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET name = ISNULL(b.label, 'none') FROM items t LEFT JOIN (foo s JOIN bar b ON b.id = s.other) ON s.id = t.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: self left join
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET value = ISNULL(p.value, 0) FROM items t LEFT JOIN items p ON p.id = t.id - 1; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: outer apply update
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET value = ISNULL(x.v, 0) FROM items t OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) s.value AS v FROM foo s WHERE s.id = t.id ORDER BY s.value DESC) x; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: cross apply update
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET value = x.v FROM items t CROSS APPLY (SELECT s.value + t.value AS v FROM foo s WHERE s.id = t.id) x; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: outer apply delete
cases.dml: DELETE t FROM items t OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) s.id FROM foo s WHERE s.id = t.id) x WHERE x.id IS NULL; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left join update with variable
cases.dml: DECLARE @fallback INT; SET @fallback = 5; UPDATE t SET value = ISNULL(s.value, @fallback) FROM items t LEFT JOIN foo s ON s.id = t.id WHERE t.id <> @fallback; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left join update output
cases.dml: UPDATE t SET value = COALESCE(s.value, 0) OUTPUT deleted.id, deleted.value AS old_value, inserted.value AS new_value, s.other FROM items t LEFT JOIN foo s ON s.id = t.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left join update rollback
cases.dml: BEGIN TRANSACTION; UPDATE t SET value = COALESCE(s.value, 0) FROM items t LEFT JOIN foo s ON s.id = t.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS inner_count; ROLLBACK; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
cases.readback: SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

cases.name: left join update nocount
cases.dml: SET NOCOUNT ON; UPDATE t SET value = COALESCE(s.value, 0) FROM items t LEFT JOIN foo s ON s.id = t.id; SET NOCOUNT OFF; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
